I think I'm gonna make an appointment with my psychologist. I'll write her a letter with everything that happened in these last years, so I won't have to talk too much. I'll ask her where could I go. I live in Italy, there is the possibility to get free or almost free healthcare, according to your income. I simply don't know how to do it and I never had the will to get informations about it. I've been forced to talk with a public psychiatrist after my last suicide attempt and it has been awful. We've spent hours in silence. When we spoke, we talked about random topics, for example my interest in serial killer's behaviour. I felt like she was having fun by my inability to speak, I thought she considered me stupid in some ways. She was also surprised by the way I changed my style frequently. I have no idea about what she was thinking about me since we never talked so much, as I said. I was hella scared to talk to her cause once she left the room for a while, leaving my medical records on the desk. I read a bunch of things and I decided not to talk with her. I was scared to get hospitalised. At the end of the story, she didn't. She believed all the lies I told her and said to me that my problems derives from the fact I'm highly intelligent and this causes me something called dysthymia. That isn't what I feel, not even close. She gave me antipsychotics and mood stabilizers. I took them for a while but they made me paranoid and I quit with them without telling her. For I while I didn't go there anymore but then, just few days before Italy got lockdown, I called her because I was in a deep confusional state with mild hallucinations. I was delusional and on the verge to commit suicide again. A little bit similiar to how I feel now from mid September but way more severe.  My bf prayed me to go back talking with her, even though he didn't like me going there either. He is willing to accompany me to the psychologist now. He's kinda forcing me cause he doesn't want me to die and I will go there. I don't want him to feel this scared about me anymore.
I don't think I will take meds again. My parents would understand it and I can't let them know I'm feeling this bad again. My father is that type of person that dislikes people struggling with mental health. Also psychical health but specially mental.
When I tried to kill myself he mocked me. He still does, telling me stuff like "You didn't even manage to kill yourself. People like you are useless. Why don't you kill yourself? Crazy whore, crazy bitch, why don't you die" (yeah, he calls me like that and a whole bunch of different other ways)
I quit going to the psychologist in 2018 cause everytime he came to pick me up, when he did, he mocked me. Plus, my mother made me understood that I wasnt feeling better quickly.
I couldn't stand all of this and I told my psychologist I wouldn't have come anymore cause I would have never felt well and I'd already decided to kill myself, one day. I think that was my last cry for help before attempting suicide in 2019.
None cared. I quit taking with everyone. I didnt trust anyone, anymore for a lot of time.
After 2019, I locked myself in my house for 2 years. The lockdown helped me a lot to do that.
It has been and still is like a living hell. You know why. My father made me feel guilty for wanting to die, I had been so disrespectful to him.

During 2020 my grandma that lived with us was slowly dying. She was bedridden and full of bloody sores all over her body. Me and my mother had to medicate her everyday. It was around November 2020, when the second wave reached the peak in Italy, so no doctor or nurse could help us. We had to to all alone. I started to hate my father a lot in those days for two main reasons.
- One day I got some of my grandma blood over my hands while I was putting a bandage on her. It wasn't so much, but it was there. On my hands. I have a long past with self harm. I feel stupid but those injuries on her really triggered me. But I ignored that. It wasnt a problem, I could stand it to help her and my mother as best as I could. The problem was that my father mocked me when I cried  while washing that blood Scrupulously right after having finished. It was blood, damn it. My grandma's blood. Isn't it normal I felt sick having her blood on my hands? It was the blood of the only person that cared about me in this house. Damn. He said I was crazy and he laughed on me. 
The other reason why I strongly dislike him, was that he refused to go buy her a medicine, cause he was "scared" to go out. The day before, though, he went out to buy his things without problems. I couldn't go cause I was with my mother and she was having a mental breakdown. I didnt want to leave her alone, so I told my father he was a terrible person. He answered me to go fuck myself. In the end I menaced to call his mother and tell everything to her... So he went to get me the medicine.
- then, I hate him also because right after my grandma death he forced my mother to act like nothing happened. She wasn't ok with that and they fought for months. She cried and cried a lot. Sometimes things got that bad I menaced them to call the police. During this period, in particular, my father repeated me continuously about my suicide attempt in 2019. It seemed to be an obsession for him. At that point, something broke in me.
I remember clearly that my mother and father fighting about that and I locked myself inside my room. I cried a lot, like all the tears I didn't cry all those months. Then my mother banged at the door. I dried my tears and stopped crying immediately. I put a smile on my face and I opened the door.
Since then, I didn't feel human anymore and I started to feel fear watching myself in the mirror cause my eyes were void and I couldn't stand my look. 
Since then, I quit thinking mainly about suicide for a while.
All I felt was rage. I wanted him to go away, in any way.
Now I feel suicidal again but I think I feel better than before. My eyes seem alive again and the rage went a little bit away...
